title: Fun gadget
text: Fun gadget. This makes perfect boiled eggs with no mess or cleanup.

product_metadata.title: Elite Gourmet EGC322CW Easy Egg Cooker Electric 7-Egg Capacity, Soft, Medium, Hard-Boiled Egg Cooker with Auto Shut-Off, Measuring Cup Included, BPA Free, Classic White
features: SEVEN EGG CAPACITY: Cook up to 7 eggs in soft, medium, or hard-boiled firmness, while saving time and water. Eggs come out consistently perfect, shell is easy to peel, and cleanup is simple!

EASE OF USE: Fill measuring cup with water to desired doneness & add to the cooking plate, press the power button once and within minutes your eggs will be "Egg-Celent!" Fun and simple to use for the entire family! The built-in timer, buzzer and auto-shut off gets it right everytime! Faster than conventional stovetop methods!
VERSATILITY: Whether pairing with avocado toast or preparing deviled eggs, the Elite Gourmet Easy Egg Cooker is an all-in-one egg boiler, veggie or food steamer, and more!

COMPACT SPACE-SAVING DESIGN: Perfect as a back-to-school gift for dorms, apartments, RVs or the office. Compact and lightweight, it easily fits into drawers for storage or just leave out on the counter as a fun and colorful accent to any home kitchen.

WHATS INCLUDED? Egg Cooker base; Dishwasher Safe Removable Parts include: 7-Egg Tray, Measuring cup with firmness markings and Clear Lid. Also included is an Instruction Manual with 16 delicious recipes!
description: The Elite Gourmet Automatic Easy Egg Cooker cooks up to 7 eggs at one time. Eliminate the guesswork of stovetop boiling by using the included measuring cup which allows you to add the exact amount of water to consistently prepare eggs to your desired style, soft medium or hard boiled. The convenient automatic shut-off indicator light & audible buzzer lets you know exactly when the cooking cycle is complete. The built-in timer adjusts automatically from soft to hard and cooks eggs exactly to your liking! The included measuring cup has a built-in piercing pin to pierce the egg shell and prevent cracked shells during cooking. This also releases the sulfur within the egg which results in consistently perfect golden yellow yolks. Prepare quick and healthy breakfast meals or even just snacks for the whole family! Designed to make busy mornings easier and to save you time & money. The Elite Gourmet Easy Egg Cooker can quickly boil eggs in the morning while you are brushing your teeth! Just add eggs & water then push the power button and within minutes your eggs will be ready! After cooking, use the egg tray handles to hold the egg tray under cold water to rinse and cool down if you need to peel them right away. Pair your boiled eggs with toast and avocado for a hearty breakfast or brunch. Prepare deviled eggs for you, two or the office potluck. Included with your purchase: Egg Cooker Base, (dishwasher safe parts include 7 egg tray, clear lid and measuring cup with piercing pin). Also included with the Instruction Manual are 16 delicious recipes. Do not use outdoors.
